parsed.rationale: Both participating records carry is_test=true and reside in Shared/Playlist/Tests/PlaylistTests/PlaylistFetcherTests.swift. The two methods — fetchPlaylistReturnsEmptyOnURLError (line 65) and fetchPlaylistReturnsEmptyOnCancellationError (line 103) — are distinct test cases that exercise different error paths (URLError vs. CancellationError); their structural similarity (Jaccard 0.73) reflects the natural shape of error-path tests in the same test class, not unintentional duplication. Merging or extracting them would obscure which error condition each test is asserting and reduce test-failure legibility.
